packages.name: FFmpeg
packages.sourceInfo: Built from FFmpeg commit 46d899d7a02bc63237472cc4897258d5ddf274ac in ghcr.io/btbn/ffmpeg-builds/win64-lgpl-8.1@sha256:a0ac6b9b3b89cf1f3f0b6cb3556dceb6b6acec22946b4d8f79af516099b920fa. Per the build script/source offer, the custom configure removed only --enable-chromaprint; no --enable-gpl and no --enable-nonfree are present. Build script: src-tauri/resources/licenses/ffmpeg-build-script.sh. ffmpeg.exe SHA-256 3091264B90D26398E0366B0E422E16FD76D2ECF85868E4F072209721E7C793F3; ffprobe.exe SHA-256 CB47EFF47532A4F5CE8F3A0FB76FDED41BD401D168C61C7DD187EBBC318B8CAD.
packages.comment: Custom LGPL build containing ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe. License confirmed locally by bundled LGPLv3 text, ffmpeg -L and --enable-version3. No --enable-gpl/--enable-nonfree and no chromaprint/FFTW in the current buildconf. Corresponding source archive and exact BtbN scripts.d/patches are not bundled. ffprobe.exe is assumed to share the same build and static dependency set; not separately itemized.
